prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1313; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was making a left turn. Our client sustained injuries in this incident and has asked us to handle all matters arising from it. Please direct all further communication regarding this claim to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, in writing, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits of the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page confirming those limits. Please also confirm whether any other policies may apply.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event recorder information, repair and total loss records, witness statements, recorded calls, claim file notes, and any surveillance or dashcam footage. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of these materials while the claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written response to each of these requests.
